description: Explicit runtime-compilation experiment: unchanged seven-query controls plus expressions evaluated over the same 1000-row fixture. Integer/text outputs remain compatible with every existing comparison adapter.

workloads.name: pk_hit
workloads.sql: SELECT score FROM items WHERE id = $1

workloads.name: pk_miss
workloads.sql: SELECT score FROM items WHERE id = $1

workloads.name: filtered_scan
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score FROM items WHERE score >= $1 ORDER BY id

workloads.name: aggregate
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(score) FROM items WHERE bucket = $1

workloads.name: group
workloads.sql: SELECT bucket, count(*), sum(score) FROM items GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

workloads.name: sort_limit
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score FROM items ORDER BY score DESC, id LIMIT 20

workloads.name: arithmetic_filter
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score FROM items WHERE score * 3 + bucket >= $1 ORDER BY id

workloads.name: arithmetic_projection
workloads.sql: SELECT id, (score::i64 * 3 + bucket::i64) / (bucket::i64 + 1) FROM items WHERE bucket >= $1 ORDER BY id

workloads.name: case_projection
workloads.sql: SELECT id, CASE WHEN score >= $1 THEN score::i64 * 3 + bucket::i64 ELSE -score::i64 END FROM items ORDER BY id

workloads.name: aggregate_argument
workloads.sql: SELECT sum((score * 3 + bucket) / (bucket + 1)) FROM items WHERE bucket >= $1

workloads.name: computed_sort
workloads.sql: SELECT id, score FROM items ORDER BY score * 3 + bucket DESC, id LIMIT 20
